intro: Web hosting, e-commerce, publishing, and digital media bore the brunt of WordPress-focused attacks between April and September 2026, with global impact recorded across all 15 reported incidents. Six critical and four high-severity vulnerabilities dominated the threat landscape, including CVE-2019-25763, CVE-2026-4883, CVE-2026-6433, and CVE-2026-82923, each carrying a CVSS score of 9.8. CVE-2021-47926, rated 6.4, also featured among the top exposures. Digital publishing was additionally affected. The archive covers activity from 2026-04-13 to 2026-09-05, reflecting a severity mix of six critical, five medium, and four high findings across the WordPress ecosystem.
